_note: Phone heat (owner 2026-11-13), read by src/autoload/quality.gd; visual cost only, no gameplay number. fps_play = frame cap while a level or Bottle Shot plays; fps_menu = cap on the map, menus, result, revive, pause and age screen; menu_boost_s = seconds at fps_play after any touch in the menus (smooth scrolling and panel openings); end_full_s = seconds a finished level keeps fps_play (its burst and confetti); menu_3d_off = nothing 3D drawn while the map covers the street; menu_low_processor = Godot's low-processor mode in the menus (no frame drawn when nothing changed). render_width = the 3D scene's width in pixels before it is stretched to the screen (scale = render_width / screen width, clamped to render_scale_min..1; the 2D UI is always full size); scaling = bilinear or fsr. shadows = the sun casts shadows; shadow_mode = split2 (two cascades, as before 2026-11-13) or orthogonal (one: the crowds' shadows are drawn once a frame instead of twice); shadow_distance = metres of street with shadows; glow = the HDR bloom; spot_shadows = the Bottle Shot stash spotlights cast shadows; dof = low (Godot's default) or very_low (box bokeh) depth-of-field blur. low_end = the values a low-end phone uses instead (detect: RAM in GB at or below ram_gb_max, or a GPU name matching one of the patterns, * and ? wildcards).

low_end._note: Overrides for a low-end phone (same keys as above).
